text:
Maya: Hey folks — quick ask. I need the canonical dashboard(s) for: service overview + per-model health + regional latency breakdown (eu, us, apac). I can only find a generic "Service KPIs" board and it's missing the region variable. Also I'm getting p99 spikes in tok-cpu in eu-west, where do I pull traces/logs for that?

Samir: @Maya — fwiw there are two dashboards we usually use. I'll paste links in a sec. Are you missing Grafana perms or the region dropdown itself?

Maya: I'm not seeing the region var on the dashboard UI (no dropdown). Grafana shows me view-only but the dropdown seems absent.

Kevin: Link dump:
- service overview: https://grafana.internal.redwood.io/d/8G2f-service-overview?orgId=1
- model health (by model + region): https://grafana.internal.redwood.io/d/2kL0-model-health?orgId=1&var-region=all
- region heatmap: https://grafana.internal.redwood.io/d/xb9a-region-latency?orgId=1&var-cluster=tok-cpu

Kevin: If the region var is missing it's usually because your org role doesn't include the dashboard variable or the folder-level template is blocked. Try opening the model health link above with `&var-region=eu-west-1` appended to force it. Example: https://grafana.internal.redwood.io/d/2kL0-model-health?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west-1

Lucy: For traces: we use Tempo. Query via the trace link in the service card (click trace icon). If you want a direct quick query for recent high-p99 spans in tok-cpu use the trace_id from logs or run a Loki query: 
```
{cluster="tok-cpu", level="error"} |~ "p99" | line_format "{{.timestamp}} {{.message}}"
```
That should give you the logs near the spike timestamps.

Maya: Thanks — I appended the var and it loaded. Two follow-ups: 1) how do I request folder-level access so the var shows up by default? 2) Any quick alert tuning advice — currently we get noisey p95 alerts on low-traffic models.

Samir: For perms open an access request in the infra self-serve: https://idp.redwood.local/access-requests -> choose Grafana -> folder: "Platform Observability" -> role: "Viewer+Vars". Leave a note with the dashboard UID (2kL0) so infra can attach the template variable. I can escalate if you need it today.

Kevin: Alert tuning: if alerts are noisy, consider increasing the evaluation window or switching from p95 to p95_over_5m with a count threshold so single-request jitter doesn't fire. Example alert expr: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) > 0.5` and add `for: 10m` in the rule. Also add `labels: {severity: warning}` for lower-priority models.

obs-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4873 — Grafana folder var grant for Maya. Assignee: eng-platform. ETA: 48h. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Awesome, that's perfect. If the infra ticket stalls @Samir can you snipe it? :pray:

Samir: Yup, I'll follow up if no movement by EOD.

Kevin: If you need raw host metrics (GPU/CPU) use the Prometheus node exporter panels on the region heatmap dashboard. For traces + flamegraphs, use Tempo + Jaeger UI link from the trace card.

Maya: Got it — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
